synopsis: AS 21815.1:2023 is described as Standards Australia's published, modified adoption of ISO 21815-1:2022, covering collision warning and avoidance on earth-moving machinery [f2259, f2721, f15027]. It carries testing requirements from ISO 21815-1 with Australian modifications, but those modifications were not found in freely accessible material and were not verified, leaving their content uncertain [f2722, f2260, f2872]. The glossary repeats that the booklet could not read the modifications, while Chapter 3 also reports that a Standards Australia catalogue entry was not located; this is a documentation gap rather than proof that the standard is unpublished [f15156, f2873, f2721]. AS 21815.1:2023 is not law unless incorporated by a regulator or a contract, a qualification also stated for the related communication-interface and object-detection standards [f2263, f15157, f15536].
